content: Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI) BIBREF7, a three-way sentence pair classification task with 393K training instances, to identify premise-hypothesis relations. There are separate development and test sets for genre-matched and genre-mismatched premise-hypothesis pairs; we tune our models solely on the genre-matched development set.
